environment: Fresh Pleos Connect 2.1.0 / Android 14 API34 x86_64 / Emulator 36.6.11 / 2560x1440

runtime.scope: Signed release on stock Pleos; synthetic GNSS and public virtual vehicle controls
runtime.nativeNavigationForegroundInterruption: Built-in navigation foregrounded during the test; reopened the existing app to continue. No app signal or result injection.

criteria.observationCoverage: At least 5 moving observations, 10 seconds, 2 evaluated categories and continuous valid speed coverage; unavailable categories shown separately

limits: Emulator vehicle inputs and GNSS are synthetic; no physical-car validation
Score is a versioned prototype practice metric, not an official test score or validated safety rating
Turn detection requires movement, heading change and matching steering; unavailable evidence is unassessed
Next-practice goals are carried to the course picker and driving screen; route geometry is not optimized to add more of a particular maneuver
Abrupt braking may have a valid cause; observation asks for parked review
